tasks.label: Stop Dev (free ports 3000/4000)
args: foreach ($p in 3000,4000) { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction Stop; "killed listener PID $_ on $p" } catch {} } }; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'dev:backend|dev:frontend|tsx watch src/server.ts|vite/bin/vite.js|/d /s /c vite|/d /s /c tsx' } | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction Stop; "killed PID $($_.ProcessId)" } catch {} }; 'Ports 3000 and 4000 are free'
